content: Create an corner with two 140x140 plates at a 90° angle to each other. The first plate has in its center a cutout of 45x45. All plates are 10mm thick | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first.
